0022600162.text: The Wizards (3-3, 2nd in the Southeast and 7th in the East) head into their seventh game of the season on a one-game winning streak, but they are 1-2 on the road. They visit the Orlando Magic (2-3, 4th in the Southeast, half a game back, and 9th in the East), who also have a one-game winning streak but are 0-2 at home. Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain). The Wizards lost their 2025-26 season series to Orlando 1-3, including a 136-131 loss in Orlando on March 12, and this is the first meeting of the 2026-27 season.
